content.short: Smart money app combining stablecoin, fiat rails, IBAN, SEPA/SWIFT and card.
content.description: UR is a blockchain-based neobank, launched with backing from Mantle, that unifies crypto and fiat money in a single account bridging traditional finance and DeFi. Live across 45+ countries, it gives users an IBAN with SEPA and SWIFT access, multi-currency support spanning USD, EUR, SGD, HKD, JPY, CHF, and more, a card for everyday spending, and instant crypto-to-fiat conversion at low fees. Through a partnership with Ethena, UR integrates the USDe stablecoin so users can hold digital dollars and earn yield, with settlement anchored to Ethereum-based assets. Positioned as a 'smart money app,' UR targets globally minded consumers who want to spend, save, and move value seamlessly across fiat and stablecoins from one account, combining bank-grade rails with on-chain finance.
content.meta: UR is a crypto-and-fiat neobank with IBAN, cards, and USDe stablecoin support. Discover UR and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
